Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Platform
Finlytics is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to build and scale our payments infrastructure.

What you'll do:
- Design and build high-throughput REST APIs and microservices for payment processing
- Own services end to end on AWS: design, deployment, monitoring
- Work with product and data teams on reconciliation and ledger systems

Requirements (must have):
- 5-8 years of backend development experience
- Strong Python (Django, Flask or FastAPI)
- Hands-on AWS experience (Lambda, ECS/EKS, RDS)
- Solid understanding of relational databases

Nice to have:
- Apache Kafka or other event streaming
- PostgreSQL performance tuning
- Docker and containerised deployments
- Fintech or payments background

Location: Pune office, hybrid; remote within India is fine for the right candidate.
